headline: What In-Kind Benefits in Lieu of Salary Do Employers Pay, and Why They Are Calling for Meal Voucher Increase to €10
summary: Ten in-kind benefits in lieu of salary can be paid by businesses to employees. Calls are growing to increase the meal voucher to €10.
why: In-kind benefits such as meal vouchers are a component of total employment cost, so changes to their limits affect employers' payroll expenses.
